headline.text: L3 ML4 unfilled bars reached packaging — *2 pallets* held for inspection after mold jams caused scrape-off failures.

summary: One active hold at L3 ML4 (unfilled bars). L3 ML1 had two food-safety events overnight — glycol leak onto molds/hopper and gasket failure into chocolate system — both resolved after cleaning and QA sign-off. L2 sorter still down pending felt-material replacement QA won't approve for cleaning.

holds.title: 2 pallets held — bars with no filling
holds.summary: Packaging found bars with only chocolate (no caramel/cream center); 2 pallets and 1 partial isolated for rework after mold jams caused poor scrape-off at demolding.
holds.status: On hold pending rework — team knows how to identify affected bars, rework form in progress per Preston's request.

food_safety.title: Plate gasket broke — pieces into chocolate system
food_safety.summary: ML1 hopper plate gasket failed at 03:20 MT, piece lodged in nozzle block; hopper drained, all gasket fragments recovered and counted by QA before cleaning.
food_safety.status: Resolved — hopper cleaned, ATP passed, new gasket installed, line restarted 08:40 MT.

food_safety.title: Glycol leak onto molds and hopper interior
food_safety.summary: Glycol valve opened during operation, leaked onto 2 molds and inside ML1 hopper; molds and hopper pulled, cleaned, ATP passed before restart.
food_safety.status: Resolved — all affected parts cleaned, ATP passed, valve hose connection corrected and inspected by maintenance.

food_safety.title: Metal scraper found by guillotine
food_safety.summary: Nathan found a metal scraper near the S4 guillotine at 08:42 MT; no metal scrappers allowed in that zone — team reminded to follow tool control.
food_safety.status: Resolved — scraper removed, supervisors reminded crew of tool restriction for that area.

food_safety.title: C6 belt patch detaching — FM risk
food_safety.summary: ML1 C6 belt tear was patched; Angel flagged bottom patch already came off and top patch may follow — concerned pieces could enter product as foreign material.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance confirmed 4 spare C6 belts in stock; belt still in use with monitoring as of window close.

quality.title: S1 metal detector sensitivity fault
quality.summary: Metal detector triggered 5 times in short period at 10:00 MT with no metal found in product; over-sensitive after morning adjustment, Jorel corrected settings.
quality.status: Resolved — sensitivity dialed back, no false rejects in final 30 minutes of shift per Jorel at 10:32 MT.

sanitation.title: Sorter felt material — QA won't approve
sanitation.summary: QA will not pass L2 sorter for production until felt-material guide piece is replaced; material cannot be cleaned adequately to meet standard.
sanitation.status: Open — Dave Ruff reached out for quote on all sorter consumables; exploring metal-detectable silicone rubber replacement.

sanitation.title: Sorting area Level 4 ATP failure
sanitation.summary: Level 4 sanitation zone in sorting area failed ATP verification; still not passed as of 05:33 MT.
sanitation.status: Open — awaiting re-clean and re-test; no update posted by window close.

allergen.title: Nut allergen spatula near wash area
allergen.summary: Jorel found nut-allergen spatula stored in tote by wash area — housekeeping/segregation gap, no cross-contact event reported.
allergen.status: Open — Jorel requested removal at 12:59 MT; no confirmation posted.

opportunities.text: Audit sorter and panner for non-cleanable materials — today's felt guide piece flagged by QA as unapprovable; Dave's ordering consumables, but worth checking entire L2 moulding for similar items before next sanitation audit.

Consider adding mold auto-reject flags during line-down events to ML4 recipe — today's unfilled bars traced to mold jams causing poor scrape-off, and Preston noted settings exist to auto-flag high-risk molds when line stops.

Review ML1 glycol valve connection procedure — today's leak at 03:47 MT was caused by improper hose seating; Raoul's video showed tube wasn't inserted far enough, and Chad noted lack of slack created pinch/bend point.
